On Sundays we walked along Defensa from Plaza de Mayo to Parque Lezama, the classic San Telmo walk.

Plaza Dorrego is the historic heart of San Telmo, surrounded by colonial buildings.

San Telmo is full of history, cobbled streets and old colonial houses.

Afterwards we took a bus from Plaza de Mayo to the Cementerio de la Recoleta.

We also had lunch near the Mercado de San Telmo, which is a great food stop.
